title: Axolotl Blastema Dissociation into Single Cell Suspension
author: Nicholas Leigh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qmmdu46
materials: Narcotize animals in 0.1% Tricaine prepared in 40% Holtfreter's. Tricaine methanesulfonate MS222 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) After survival surgeries always keep animals overnight in 40% Holtfreter's supplemented with 0.5% sulfamerazine. Sulfamerazine sodium salt Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #S0800

With iridectomy scissors cut parallel to the plane of the limb around the circumference of the blastema where it interfaces with the stump. Slide a forcep between the WE and blastema, and slowly peel away the wound epidermis. At this point you can either discard the wound epidermis or put the wound epidermis and blastema (post-separation) into the microcentrifuge tube with papain. Start a timer counting up. Thoroughly clean iridectomy scissors and forceps with RNase Zap prior to use. RNase Zap Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #R2020-250ML

After final pipette step, use a p1000 pipette to pass cells through a 70µm cell strainer into the bottom of a sterile, tissue culture-treated 6-well plate. Wash microcentrifuge tube with 600µl of 0.7X HBSS to collect any cells that remained in the tube and pass this through the cell strainer into the 6-well plate. With 2mL 0.7X HBSS wash the cell strainer, making sure that 0.7X HBSS passing through the strainer enters the 6-well plate. After all straining/washes, there should be 3mL of cell containing solution in one well of a 6-well plate Falcon™ Cell Strainers Fisher Scientific Catalog #08-771-2 Costar® 6 Well Clear TC-Treated Multiple Well Plates, Individually Wrapped, Sterile Westnet Catalog #3516 10X HBSS Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #14185-052

Towards the end of the incubation fill a 3mL syringe with 25 1/2 gauge needle with 5% Optiprep solution. steps.title: Prepare HBSS and Optiprep solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute 10X HBSS with UltraPure DNase/RNase‑Free distilled water to obtain 0.7X HBSS. Using 0.7X HBSS, prepare OptiPrep (Iodixanol) dilutions of 5 % v/v, 10 % v/v, and 15 % v/v. Keep all solutions on ice before use.

steps.title: Make papain digestion solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 10X DPBS with UltraPure DNase/RNase‑Free distilled water to 0.7X HBSS. Add 2.5 mL of this 0.7X HBSS to the papain vial (Worthington PDS Kit, catalog LK003178) and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min to dissolve papain. After dissolution, transfer 400 µL of the papain solution to an RNase‑free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube; papain should be at room temperature before use.

steps.title: Dissociate tissue with papain and rocking
steps.instruction: Place the tissue‑containing papain tube on a nutating rocker and rock for 10 min, ensuring tissue does not stick to the tube walls. Then:

substeps.instruction: Using a P1000 pipette, gently pipette the tissue 20–30 times (first few passes may require extra force to draw tissue into the tip). This takes ~1 min. Return tube to rocker for 5 min.
At 15 min post‑harvest, repeat the 20–30 gentle pipettings and rock for another 5 min.
At 20, 25, and 30 min post‑harvest, repeat the gentle pipetting (20–30 strokes) followed by 5 min rocking each time.

steps.title: Settle cells on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the dissociated cell suspension to a 6‑well plate, place the plate on ice, and let cells settle to the bottom for 10 min.

steps.title: Layer 5% Optiprep and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a 3 mL syringe, slowly layer 3 mL of 5 % Optiprep down the side of each well without disturbing the settled cells. Allow cells to resettle for 1–2 min, then remove ~3 mL of the overlying 0.7X HBSS (which has risen above the denser Optiprep) with a P1000 pipette, aspirating from the same location where the Optiprep was added.

steps.title: Layer 10% Optiprep and remove 5% layer
steps.instruction: Let the cells sit ~1 min, then fill a syringe with 10 % Optiprep and slowly layer it over the 5 % Optiprep. After a brief resettling, remove the underlying 5 % Optiprep layer with a P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Layer 15% Optiprep and remove 10% layer
steps.instruction: Fill a syringe with 15 % Optiprep and slowly layer it over the 10 % Optiprep. After cells resettle, remove the 10 % Optiprep layer with a P1000 pipette, leaving the cells in the remaining 15 % Optiprep.

steps.title: Collect and wash cells
steps.instruction: Using a P1000, remove ~5.5 mL of the 10 %/15 % Optiprep mixture, leaving ≤200 µL of 15 % Optiprep that contains the cells. Swirl the well and pipette gently to wash the bottom, then transfer the cell suspension to an RNase‑free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Assess cell viability
steps.instruction: Count cells with trypan blue; viability should be >90 % (actual concentration will vary with blastema size and final volume).

steps.title: Adjust BSA to 0.5%
steps.instruction: Estimate the total volume of the cell‑containing 15 % Optiprep using a P1000. Add molecular‑biology‑grade BSA (20 mg/mL, NEB catalog B9000S) to achieve a final concentration of 0.5 % (e.g., add 0.5 µL of the 20 mg/mL BSA solution per 100 µL of cell suspension).
